'''Aurek Battalion''' was a [[Battalion/Legends|division]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. It was decimated during a [[bombing run]] in the [[Invasion of Begeren]].<ref name="Shades of the Sith" />
